hypothesis: Paid target risk labels can shift source functional variance toward a public function family, reducing incompatible source directions without knowing target support.
model: Each original eta source component has prior mass 0.5 unchanged and 0.5 on covariance reweighting. On family B and rho in [0,1], C_function=(1-rho)*C_source_function + rho*trace(C_source_function)*diag(1_B/|B|). Keep the source intercept, means and candidate discrepancy; total function variance is fixed at its source value.
prior_and_inference: Uniform prior on the six public families and uniform rho on [0,1], integrated with 32-node Gauss-Legendre quadrature. Preserve equal initial original source-component weights; infer family/rho/component weights only from paid training eta labels and retain the full predictive mixture. No hyperparameter search or hard winning-family selection.
validation: All 160 old paths, seeds 48-63, all five regimes, both source priors and 8/24 prefixes. Reuse exact A3 candidate-group holdouts and control scores; exclude every held candidate repeat. No target truth/support, verifier outcomes or future labels enter fitting. Both controls receive the same reweighting family.
preserved: Source-learned risk covariance informs every branch, including its nonuniform within-family shape at rho<1. All f/g models, dictionary normalization, old query paths, recommendation utility and independent verifier are retained.
resource_admission: Measure the first complete learned-prior path and retain it. Stop with partial evidence if the full-cohort forecast exceeds the 0.25-hour local CPU cap.
recommendation_replay_gate: Broad learned-prior predictive improvement without material compatible-regime regression is required before retrospective recommendation replay. Predictive results do not authorize new closed-loop searches.
limitations: Tests coarse family-level covariance adaptation, not sparse exact-support recovery, variance-scale learning or high-dimensional representation learning. Fixed source variance may still be insufficient under amplitude shift. Same development cohort as A3-A8, not independent confirmation. Preserve negative results without automatically expanding model families.
scoring: All five strata, both source controls, both prefixes, paired seed changes and nominal bootstrap intervals. Primary endpoint remains 24-batch learned-source held-out log score.
numerical_check: Minimum null-posterior fold per stratum plus worst-regression fold of four retained failure paths. Compare 32/64/96 Gauss-Legendre points; changes above 1e-4 joint log-score units require higher integration order before interpretation.
numerical_fit: Whiten the source training covariance and diagonalize each signed family covariance change. Retain negative eigenvalues to permit variance reduction; evaluate the full branch predictive mixture at fixed rho quadrature points.
